title: orobanche minor subsp. ozanonis
intro: Orobanche minor subsp. ozanonis, commonly known as the Ozankaya broomrape, is a parasitic plant species belonging to the Orobanchaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat gastrointestinal issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche minor subsp. ozanonis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may also contribute to its use in treating respiratory and urinary tract infections. However, the bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties have not been extensively studied, and further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and potential interactions.
